LanguageData.WTW_Settings_MapMutatorsDescription:
Map mutators affect the map generation - for example, "Caves" mutator will force the map to have caves. Odyssey landmarks are mutators, too.

By default, Walk the World will remove any ruin-related structures when you are leaving a landmark map - this will prevent from abusing the loot and is considered a fair option. You can disable it, if you like - although it is counts as a "cheating".

Choose, which mutators should be removed when you are leaving a landmark map. You can also add modded mutators here so that modded ruins would also work well with Walk the World mod.
LanguageData.WTW_Settings_MapMutatorsRemoveDescriptio: Click the button below to see what mutators are marked for deletion on leaving. Click on the mutator to remove it from the list.
